operators.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_forward
semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: x = self.adaptive_avg_pool(x) where self.adaptive_avg_pool is nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((output_h, output_w)).
Computes adaptive average pooling over 2D spatial dimensions with output size (output_h, output_w).
For each output element at (b,c,oh,ow), averages input over spatial window [floor(oh*H/outH), ceil((oh+1)*H/outH)) x [floor(ow*W/outW), ceil((ow+1)*W/outW)).
No padding, no stride parameter; output spatial size is exactly output_h, output_w.
Output stride follows contiguous PyTorch layout for [N,C,outH,outW].

operators.name: view_flatten_forward
semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: x = x.view(x.size(0), -1).
Flattens the tensor to shape (batch_size, num_features) where num_features is the product of all dimensions after batch.
Preserves data order: x[b, c, h, w] maps to x[b, c*H*W + h*W + w].
No copy is performed; returns a view with the same storage.
Output shape is [batch_size, remaining_numel] and is contiguous.

operators.name: linear_forward
semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: x = self.linear(x) where self.linear is nn.Linear(in_features, out_features, bias=True).
Computes output = input @ weight.T + bias (if bias is not None).
Broadcasts bias over batch dimension.
Uses cuBLAS GEMM for matrix multiplication; bias addition may be fused in the same kernel.
Output is contiguous [batch, out_features].
Adaptive average pooling with output size (2,2) as set in constructor kernel_size.
Input x is [4,3,512,512] float32 CUDA; output is [4,3,2,2] float32 CUDA.
Each output element averages the corresponding adaptive window; no learnable parameters.
Flattens the pooled tensor [4,3,2,2] to [4,12] along feature dimensions.
x.size(0) is the batch dimension, retained as 4.
Reshape is a view, no data movement.
Linear transformation: input [4,12] to output [4,16].
Weight is [16,12], bias is [16], both float32 CUDA.
Computes X @ W^T + b.
Final output of forward: [4,16] float32 CUDA tensor.
